description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/01-store/forms/read-checks.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); P01.228). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Constraints only where the header of the form or the existing check states them; CEL, JSON, owner, typed, numeric and prose-agreement rules stay with the existing checks.

fields.name: n
fields.description: The order 1, 2, …; physical order stays with the existing check.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The stable address of the row, prefixed rd-, independent of check and the order n; not renamed or renumbered.

fields.name: op
fields.description: * in every row: the request object has no field op.

fields.name: each
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema.

fields.name: check
fields.description: The refusal name in refusals.tsv; several checks may select the same refusal.

fields.name: when
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema.

fields.name: fault
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema. Empty: no fields.
